rv.q: LEGALLY BLONDE is a joyful, contemporary twist on the always popular Cinderella story.
Music Theater Works has done such a good job with its productions this season.
This is a put together show, just like the main character, Elle Woods.
LEGALLY BLONDE is F-U-N and in vogue! Don't wait, buy a ticket and get to the show before the run ends this weekend!
Full of talent and pizzazz, Legally Blonde the Musical is the perfect musical for the family.
Elle is played to perfection by Kayla Shipman... this is a smooth running play that makes 2 hours and 25 minutes go quickly.

cn.t: Music Theater Works delivers a joyful, polished production that's pure fun. Critics praise the energetic cast, stellar orchestra, and spirited performances that make this contemporary Cinderella story a delightful crowd-pleaser.
